description: Stage-0 ground-truth micro-corpus for the method-matching engine. Anchor = Rupert's porphyrin nanorod paper. Positives v2 approved by Rupert 2026-08-29 after redefinition: relatedness = same METHOD USED THE SAME WAY in a different domain (never shared phenomenon/physics, never domain labels). Presentation IDs refer to the GPS 2026 feed (meeting 441) archived in data/gps2026/.

anchor.title: Photoconductivity of Self-Assembled Porphyrin Nanorods
anchor.authors: Schwab, Smith, Bond-Watts, Johnston, Hone, Johnson, de Paula, W.F. Smith
method_axes: M1: molecular self-assembly as the fabrication step (molecules organize into the functional 1D conductor)
M2: photocurrent/photoconductivity measurement (light on/off, current vs time; transient shape read mechanistically)
M3: charge transport measured through a molecular/1D structure between electrodes, interpreted via molecular-orbital energetics
M4: bias-history programming with persistent state read back in transport (memory/hysteresis protocol)

positives.title: Memristive Properties of Ni-DNA Thin-Film Devices
positives.why: Identical usage pattern step for step: molecule self-assembles onto gold as the active layer (Au-thiol), I-V/voltammetry through the molecular film, resistive states programmed in a voltage window. Same assemble->contact->program-and-read loop, different molecule. No light.

positives.title: Magnetoresistive Switching in Porphene, a 2D Porphyrin Based Polymer
positives.why: Same read-out usage: switchable conduction state measured electrically through a porphyrin framework; programming input swapped (magnetic field for bias). Fabrication is polymerization, not assembly. NOTE: FIAP unit means engine's unit test calls this cross-domain - expected, not an error.

positives.title: Sequence and Phosphorylation Modifications Dictate Charge Transport in Cell-Penetrating Peptides
positives.why: Cleanest usage mirror: peptides self-assemble into the junction's active layer (M1, SAM-on-gold ~9 talks corpus-wide), and conductance through it is used as a probe of molecular electronic structure - both papers explain their currents via frontier-orbital energy alignment (anchor: coupled LUMOs). Molecular-junction club: ~10 of 11,249 talks. Problem is biochemistry (sequence/phosphorylation -> conductance).

positives.title: Chiral-induced spin selectivity in polypeptides on magnetic thin films
positives.why: Same inversion of the measurement: assembled molecular layer (thiol-anchored SAM, anchor's chemistry) is the transport medium, and transport through it is used to reveal a structural property of the molecules - their handedness, as anchor's revealed stacking. Contrast knob is a magnet instead of light. Problem is spin filtering.

positives.title: Direct observation of dynamic energy transport and high thermal conductance across solid-molecule junctions
positives.why: Same experimental design: junction built by self-assembly (alkanethiol SAMs bonded to Au(111) - most literally anchor-like fabrication in the set), then the whole study is transport dynamics across it, time-resolved. Transported quantity is heat, probe is ultrafast electron diffraction. Problem is interfacial thermal physics.

positives.title: Self-Assembly of Biomimetic Nanostructures with High Complexity
positives.why: Same role for the method: self-assembly is the synthesis step - 1D building blocks (nanofibers) organize into the functional material whose emergent property is the paper's subject; both then face the identical part-ordered/part-disordered packing problem. Emergent property studied is mechanics, not conduction - zero electronics/optics; purest M1 domain jump. Single-axis by design.

positives.title: Femto-ampere Photocurrent Measurements for the LISA GRS
positives.why: Same laboratory practice at its extreme: light onto gold, measure the resulting current at femtoampere resolution. CAVEATS (deliberate): channel is photoemission not photoconduction (cousins in the light-in/current-out family), and usage is control-tool (test-mass discharge) not material-probe. Kept as the grain-of-kinship stress test; undergraduate poster. Problem is gravitational-wave instrumentation.

positives.title: Ultrafast transient photocurrent in hybrid lead halide perovskites
positives.why: Identical inference pattern: light pulse, record photocurrent vs time on a 1D structure (microribbon), read carrier trapping/drift/recombination from the transient's shape - the anchor's exact measurement-and-reasoning loop at femtoseconds instead of milliseconds. 'Transient photocurrent' appears in 2 talks corpus-wide. Different material community (perovskite optoelectronics) - type (a).

positives.title: Helicity Dependent Photocurrent in Eshelby Twisted GeS Nanowires
positives.why: Same trick: photocurrent on a single 1D wire used to read the wire's internal organization (their built-in helical twist via polarization rotation; anchor's molecular stacking via light response). Both treat photocurrent response as a structural fingerprint of a wire's insides. Inorganic vapor-grown wires - type (a).

positives.title: Ferroelectric Field Effect in ReS2 via Self-Assembled Epitaxial P(VDF-TrFE) Nanowires
positives.why: Same two-step usage: molecules ordered (Langmuir-Blodgett + annealing; only talk in corpus naming LB) into close-packed NANOWIRES that become the device's functional element, aimed at nonvolatile programmable transport states. Assembly-into-wires as fabrication + persistent-state transport as goal = anchor's frame in the 2D-materials community - type (a). No light; switched conduction lives in the ReS2 beneath.

stretch_unscored.note: Phenomenon/behavior analogies WITHOUT shared technique - demoted 2026-08-29 when relatedness was redefined as method-usage. NOT loaded into the Stage-0 corpus and never counted as hits, misses, or false positives. Revisit if a future eval wants to test conceptual kinship.
